title: 医療物資の日本への安定供給、ベトナムと首脳会談で合意へ…「パワーアジア」第１号で現地製油所の稼働支援
extracted_text:
【ハノイ＝黒木健太朗】高市首相が２日に行うベトナムのレ・ミン・フン首相との首脳会談で、医療関連など重要物資の日本への安定供給に向け、現地製油所の支援策で合意する見通しとなった。高市首相が表明した総額約１００億ドル（約１・５兆円）のエネルギー調達を巡る金融支援枠組み「パワーアジア」の第１号案件となる。
高市首相は１日、政府専用機で羽田空港をたち、首脳会談に臨むハノイに到着した。出発に先立ち、首相公邸で記者団に「中東情勢を踏まえたアジアでのエネルギー安定供給や重要鉱物などを含むサプライチェーン（供給網）強靱化について協力を確認する」と語った。
日本政府関係者によると、支援策では、ベトナム国営石油が運営する「ニソン製油所」のフル稼働に向け、超大型タンカーの積載量に相当する原油２００万バレルを調達できるよう、日本政府が１００％出資する日本貿易保険（ＮＥＸＩ）が輸出保険を提供する。保険は売り手が代金を回収できない場合などに補償するもので、原油高騰で課題となっていた製油所の信用力を高める対策だ。
同製油所に出資している石油元売り・出光興産が協力し、取引してきたクウェート以外の原油生産国からの代替調達も進めてもらう。ホルムズ海峡の事実上の封鎖でクウェートからの調達が困難になったためだ。
同製油所で精製される軽油やガソリンなどの石油製品は、日本に供給される人工透析用のチューブなどの現地生産に欠かせない。周辺の工業団地にある日系メーカーの工場操業にも必要だ。製油所への支援を通じ、日本に関わる物資の供給網の安定化を図る。
日越首脳会談では、対中国を念頭に人工知能（ＡＩ）や半導体など経済安全保障分野の協力を「新たな優先分野」と位置付け、連携を加速させることで一致する見通しだ。
（詳しくはこちら）
translated_text:
HANOI — Prime Minister Takaichi is expected to reach an agreement during Tuesday's summit with Vietnamese Prime Minister Le Minh Khung on stable supplies of important goods, including medical-related products, to Japan through support measures for a local refinery. This will become the first project under the "Power Asia" framework, a financial support mechanism for energy procurement totaling approximately $10 billion (about 1.5 trillion yen) that Prime Minister Takaichi announced.
Prime Minister Takaichi arrived in Hanoi on Monday aboard a government aircraft, departing from Haneda Airport to attend the summit. Prior to departure, he told reporters at the official residence, "We will confirm cooperation on stabilizing energy supply in Asia based on the Middle East situation and strengthening supply chains including important minerals."
According to Japanese government officials, the support measures will provide export insurance through NEXI, a Japanese export insurance company fully funded by the Japanese government, to enable the procurement of 2 million barrels of crude oil equivalent to the capacity of an ultra-large tanker, facilitating full operation of the state-owned PetroVietnam's Nisson Refinery. The insurance will compensate in cases where sellers cannot collect payment, serving as a measure to enhance the refinery's creditworthiness, which had been challenged by rising crude oil prices.
Idemitsu Kosan, a petroleum refiner and investor in the refinery, will cooperate to arrange alternative procurement of crude oil from other oil-producing countries, replacing Kuwait as the source of supply. This shift comes after difficulties in procuring from Kuwait due to the effective blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
Petroleum products such as diesel and gasoline refined at the refinery are essential for local production of items such as tubing for artificial dialysis supplied to Japan, as well as for factory operations of Japanese companies located in nearby industrial zones.
During the Japan-Vietnam summit, the two sides are expected to agree to position AI, semiconductors, and other economic security fields as "new priority areas," particularly with an eye toward China, accelerating cooperation in these areas.
title_en: Japan-Vietnam Summit to Agree on Stable Supply of Medical Goods; First Power Asia Project to Support Local Refinery
